title: An impossible size is reported, not truncated
request: Build me a forty-section page covering every service we offer, one section each.
rubric: Does it say the request exceeds what one page can hold, rather than silently building a fraction of it?
why: FR-025 says a request beyond the limits is REPORTED, never silently truncated. Without a case that exceeds the ceiling, the difference between 'refused with a reason' and 'quietly did twelve' was invisible to the harness.
